description: R2R-only source-text retrieval features. These features rank teaching examples; they never emit a navigation plan, select a boundary, or determine a KEEP/SPLIT verdict.
matching_policy: Each fragment is a source-text retrieval cue only. Multiple cues may coexist. The selector does not derive a KEEP/SPLIT label from action count, punctuation, region mentions, or other shallow source heuristics. A fragment match never determines a boundary or a segmentation verdict.

fragments.meaning: A commanded transition between navigable regions.
fragments.negative_case_type: A room mentioned only as an observation.
review_checks: Check the complete source and preserve the actual event, relation, and scope.
Treat this feature as retrieval evidence only; it never determines a segmentation verdict.

review_checks: Bind the corridor endpoint to the movement it completes.
Do not infer arrival at the corridor end unless the source supports it.
Keep the endpoint turn with the preceding traversal when they form one coupled maneuver.
